["SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2021-07-01..2021-09-30' THEN value_num ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2020-07-01..2020-09-30' THEN value_num ELSE 0 END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2020-07-01..2020-09-30' THEN value_num ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS yoy_growth_percent, period
FROM (
  SELECT period, value_num, effective_at, learned_at, kind, evidence_id
  FROM facts
  WHERE subject = 'MRK | Revenues' AND attribute = 'value_usd_m'
) AS subquery
ORDER BY period DESC
LIMIT 1;"]
